question: At absolute zero temperature ($0 \text{ K}$), an intrinsic semiconductor acts as a perfect insulator. Interpret this behavior using the concept of energy bands.

options.A: The Conduction Band is completely empty because no thermal energy is available to cross the forbidden gap.
options.B: The Valence Band and Conduction Band overlap, trapping the electrons.
options.C: The electrons in the Valence Band are frozen and lose their charge.
options.D: The Energy Gap ($E_g$) becomes infinite at $0 \text{ K}$.
